description: Monitor and switch cswap accounts: status bar, quick switch, dashboard and optional engine.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: How often to read `cswap list`, in seconds.
config.cliPath: Absolute path of `swapdeck-cli`. Empty: the one bundled with the extension.
config.engine.enabled: Run the SwapDeck engine (`swapdeck-cli headless`) while VS Code is open. It respects the single-instance lock and the rules in the SwapDeck config.
config.notifications.thresholds: Usage thresholds (%) of the active account that raise a notification. The lowest also colors the status bar as a warning, the highest as critical.
